title: κ = 7.69571027349774217804511e-4: cross-group exchanges with growing-prime refinement
body:
κ = 7.69571027349774217804511e-4

This conditional finite construction improves frozen #323 (`769557449978832/10^18`) by replacing kernel families across three entrance groups, then applying #321's uniform growing-prime threshold and eight finite bootstrap levels to the complete new word. The exact result is `769571027349774217804511/10^27`; the structural change alone gives `769571023988249/10^18` under the predecessor arithmetic settings. All previously published heads and claims remain frozen.

The exchange replaces 55 old families with 51 new families, recomputing shared-donor costs globally. There are 1043 early kernel entries of total rank 1195 and three retained late rank-two kernels. The four presink retimings, 240 early restorations, seven terminal sinks and 133 reorder moves are rederived and verified on the new actual word. Relative to #323, the local paid histogram changes by `{1:-10, 2:-8, 3:+9, 11:-4, 12:+4}`. The word has 336227 ADDs and 48507 paid calls in 386883 records, with all 8223 arbitrary dirty helper inputs restored.

The 300-replica bank cover has 427887 banks per stage and literal stock 3291435, with 12334500 explicit helper assignments and no padding. Stock increases by 75 relative to #323; the improved paid profile more than offsets that increase. The full literal profile has 75064500 children, rank mass 328531500, and deficit 612000. Both reflected frame ledgers, 431 new frame charts, 3658 changed projector charts, and exact rank witnesses for all 14038 used frames and annihilators are checked. The complete finite coefficient is 127517659550812001 and the payload bound is 98 bits.

The arithmetic refinement preserves the inherited growing-prime regime. It imposes only an eventual lower threshold `q >= 2^127-1`, keeps the full exceptional fallback, and checks both independent rational moment engines, eight positive-gap finite bootstrap levels, and all 47 strict outer inequalities. The adjacent `10^-27` grid point is rejected. All-size compiler, weighted-selector, common-ancestor-chart, restored-row, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, and complex analytic interfaces remain explicit conditions; this is not an unconditional multiplication theorem or a constant-modulus machine.

Validation: two complete fresh replays of the same immutable 360-file package, plus a separate C++ audit of the literal forward/inverse word, COPY lifetime, dirty restoration, both paid ledgers and exact bank supply. A second rank-witness audit uses modular Gaussian determinants and exact Hadamard bounds, independently confirming all 28076 integer minors. Omitting late restoration gives nine wrong rows. Package manifest: `dda12311734d6935c11b310b3b959c650fc142cbc697dc3373eade96c58ba263`. Word SHA256: `72e78b2db88ef8f4a5c4aef48c66e5b317b99a6bee0cdcda70f50748d383ac3a`.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/p10-crossgroup-prime/vendor/predecessor/requirements.txt
python -B research/p10-crossgroup-prime/verify.py --output /tmp/p10-crossgroup-proof --cxx g++ --boost-include /usr/include
```

The package retains byte-preserved #320 and #322 sources and their original notices and disclosures. Credit remains with DreamingOfClouds for the p=10 source, Chafik Boukhalfa for #320's transcript-stage port, Rohan Arun and the cited contributors for preceding mechanisms, and #321 at `c76247701762feb2c5bea5bcf302b010eb7d1bc3` for the arithmetic primitives. The new exchanges, composition, audits, wrapper and documentation were prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; inherited Anthropic Claude/OpenAI disclosures are preserved. See `SOURCE.json`, `NOTICE.md`, `PROOF.md` and `REFINEMENT-PROOF.md`.
